title: The Fable
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A legendary hitman known as 'Fable' is ordered by his boss to live for one year as an ordinary citizen in Osaka under the name Akira Sato, protected by a yakuza clan and forbidden to kill anyone. With his assistant posing as his sister Yoko, he tries to hold down a normal job while local criminals grow suspicious of him.
life_message: It holds up the idea that even a killer can learn ordinary decency and protect others without taking life.

content.note: Several killings in the opening chapter, yakuza crime and guns (ANN reviewers; Wikipedia; AniList Assassins, Guns).
Gritty crime tension around the Maguro Group and Kojima (Wikipedia; ANN 'gritty crime story').
Akira is often fully naked at home; Misaki is blackmailed toward becoming a call girl; hidden cameras spy on Yoko (Wikipedia; ANN; AniList Nudity; MangaUpdates Nudity, Rape).
Yoko drinks men under the table on purpose (Wikipedia).
Hitman skills and firearms shown as cool; surveillance of a woman (ANN) (to verify).
Running gag about comedian Jackal Tomioka (Wikipedia).

delivery.note: Its point about ordinary decency is carried by situation comedy and Akira's restraint.

winners_losers: Akira and those he quietly protects come out ahead; scheming criminals like Kojima lose. Sympathy goes to a lethal but decent loner learning to be ordinary.
